data.provenance: QM9 (Ramakrishnan et al., Sci. Data 1, 140022, 2014; CC0) was obtained from the DeepChem/MoleculeNet mirror (https://deepchemdata.s3-us-west-1.amazonaws.com/datasets/qm9.csv) together with the authors' list of geometrically inconsistent ('uncharacterized') molecules from figshare, on 2026-11-11. It contained 133885 molecules; removing the uncharacterized set and any SMILES failing RDKit sanitisation left 130831. HOMO, LUMO and gap are B3LYP/6-31G(2df,p) values, converted from Hartree to eV. HOPV15 (Lopez et al., Sci. Data 3, 160086, 2016; CC BY 4.0) revision 2 was obtained from figshare (https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/4513735) on the same date: 350 molecules parsed, 350 retained after RDKit sanitisation. Its HOMO/LUMO/gap columns are experimental (electrochemical) values in eV with PCE in percent; B3LYP/def2-SVP orbital energies are averaged over the supplied conformers. The AM1.5G spectrum is the ASTM G173-03 table as redistributed with pvlib-python v0.11.0.

sq.method: Detailed balance (Shockley-Queisser 1961): one e-h pair per photon above Eg, radiative recombination only, cell at 300 K, ASTM G173-03 AM1.5G.

secondary_peak.cause: H2O absorption band near 1.13 um in AM1.5G

torsion.method: B3LYP/6-31G*, relaxed scan (all other coordinates optimised)

quantum.protocol: RDKit ETKDG (seed 42) -> MMFF94 -> PySCF/geomeTRIC optimisation -> single point; inter-ring dihedrals left exactly planar by MMFF94 are rotated to 160 deg first so the optimiser is not held on a symmetry-imposed saddle point.
quantum.hardware: Intel Core i5-10500H (6 cores), 16 GB RAM, 6 OpenMP threads

findings.note: Predicted: B3LYP underestimates the optical gap. Observed: for these short oligomers the B3LYP HOMO-LUMO gap is ABOVE the experimental optical gap, and the excess shrinks as the chain grows. The HOMO-LUMO gap is not the optical gap: it ignores the electron-hole attraction (exciton binding) and B3LYP's self-interaction error, which pull in opposite directions; their balance depends on size.

descriptors.conjugation_proxy_definition:
Number of heavy atoms in the largest connected conjugated (pi) system.

    Written from the bond orders and aromaticity flags rather than RDKit's own
    conjugation perception, so every step can be explained:

      1. Mark every atom that takes part in pi bonding: aromatic atoms and atoms
         with a double or triple bond (`is_pi_atom`), plus N/O/S atoms whose lone
         pair sits next to such an atom (`is_lone_pair_donor`).
      2. Two marked atoms are in the same conjugated system if they are bonded.
         Any bond between two marked atoms counts: a double/aromatic bond is part
         of the pi system itself, and a single bond between two pi atoms is what
         joins them (as in butadiene, C=C-C=C, or biphenyl).
      3. Group the marked atoms into connected pieces (a union-find, below) and
         return the size of the biggest piece.

    Examples: ethene 2, butadiene 4, benzene 6, aniline 7 (ring + N),
    biphenyl 12, a saturated molecule 0. Larger means a longer path for
    delocalised electrons, which (particle in a box) should mean a smaller gap.

    Known simplifications: geometry is ignored (a twisted biphenyl still counts as
    12), cross-conjugation counts the same as linear conjugation, and a lone-pair
    atom between two pi systems joins them.
descriptors.dye_filter_status: our own construction by analogy with Lipinski; not a literature standard

dye_filter_rules.extended_conjugation: largest conjugated system >= 6 heavy atoms (at least a benzene ring's worth)
dye_filter_rules.planarity_capable: at least half the heavy atoms are in that conjugated system; single bonds between conjugated rings are allowed (Part 3: flattening one costs < kT)
dye_filter_rules.donor_and_acceptor: contains at least one electron-donor group AND one electron-acceptor group
dye_filter_rules.thermal_stability_proxy: no 3- or 4-membered rings, no O-O, N-N, non-nitro N-O single bonds, no azide
dye_filter_rules.no_charge_separation: no formal charges except inside a nitro group (no zwitterions)
